en.specs.title: The real numbers, straight from the listing
en.s1.t: A disc tip for real precision
en.s1.b: The transparent disc tip is far more precise than a finger for writing, drawing and selecting - without missing a point.
en.s2.b: Interchangeable tips mean you can swap the head any time - a longer life and a pen that stays with you.
en.s3.b: Works on iPad, iPhone, Android devices, Microsoft tablets and every capacitive touch screen.
en.s4.b: A fully passive pen - no charging and no pairing; unlock the screen and write straight away.
en.s5.b: An aluminium enclosure in clean white, with a comfortable weight and a tidy grip for long writing.
en.s6.b: At 16.5 cm long and 0.9 cm wide - it fits a bag or pocket and can stay with you all day.
en.conn.title: Precision pen, no charging, no fuss
en.conn.sub: A passive disc stylus versus an active smart pencil - the gap is battery and sensitivity
en.conn.m1Ls: an economical price that never needs charging
en.conn.m1Bt: A higher price that needs charging and can be device-specific
en.conn.m2Ls: Everyday note-taking, browsing and light drawing
en.conn.m2Bt: Advanced drawing with pressure and tilt sensitivity
en.conn.m3Ls: Universal fit and no battery - always ready
en.conn.m3Bt: Pro features, more palm rejection and a bigger price
en.conn.noteLs: If you need to write, tap and scroll across all your devices, this pen does the job with no charging and no fuss.
en.conn.noteBt: An active pencil earns its keep for serious drawing, but most people never feel the gain in daily notes.
